correctness.rationale: Independent symbolic reconstruction confirms the recurrence and every boundary. The Jury margins reduce to t(γ+1)/(2(1+γt)), [4+3(γ-1)t]/[2(1+γt)], and a positive third margin, giving the exact finite ceiling only when γ<1. The roots have opposite signs, so the dominant factor is the displayed closed form. For 0<γ<2 the coefficient A changes sign once at t=2/(2-γ); implicit differentiation shows the factor decreases before and increases after this point. For γ at least 2, A stays positive and the factor decreases to one half. Boundary-mode calculations show the prescribed initialization cannot accidentally cancel the unstable mode.
